together.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
together.body: An app for the two of you, designed so you close it quickly and spend more time together, truly together.

gentle.title: Gentle, never pushy
gentle.body: One question a day, memories to keep, shared organization. Nothing mandatory, nothing to catch up on: you go at your own pace.

never.title: What this app will never do
never.body: Because trust matters more than anything:

items.streaks: No points, no couple score, never a reproach if you do not play.
items.tracking: Your location is shared only if you agree, and you can stop at any time.
items.ads: No ads, no tracking, no selling of data.
items.private: What you keep to yourself stays yours: the other never sees it.

coach.title: Coach
coach.subtitle: One conversation, read by both of you
coach.introTitle: A coach for the two of you
coach.intro1: You talk to it in a single conversation: each of you reads everything, there is no private exchange.
coach.intro2: It listens to both of you, then gives its view and concrete advice.
coach.intro3: The conversation is encrypted and you can erase it at any time.
coach.intro4: It is an artificial intelligence: it replaces neither a therapist nor emergency services.
coach.waiting: Waiting for {{name}}: the coach opens once you have both turned it on.
coach.unavailable: The coach is not turned on on the server yet. It will answer as soon as the key is configured.
coach.placeholder: Write to the coach, in front of both of you…
coach.empty: Tell it what is on your minds: a disagreement, a wish, an idea for a date.
coach.sendError: Your message could not be sent. It is still in the field: try again.
coach.actionError: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
coach.eraseMessage: It will be erased for both of you.
coach.intro5: Free for a month once you both open it, then included in Bolingo Plus.
coach.intro6: To answer, your messages to the coach are sent to an external artificial intelligence provider (Google, via OpenRouter), only to produce its replies. By turning it on, you agree to this sharing.
coach.trialOverMessage: You can still read your whole conversation. To keep writing to the coach, go Bolingo Plus: one subscription for both of you.
